Admissions
Primary School Admissions
If you have a child that is due to start primary school in September 2027, you need to apply for a primary school place. The deadline for applications is 15th January 2027.
To apply for a place at Notre Dame please apply via: https://www.eadmissions.org.uk/
Prospective Families -School viewings
If you are unable to attend one of our Open Days, families are warmly invited to arrange a personal tour of the school at a time that is convenient for you.
To book a visit, please contact the School Office on 020 8854 0585 or email info@notredame.greenwich.sch.uk. We would be delighted to welcome you to Notre Dame and show you around our school.
